desc: Derive the incremental algorithm: only pairs involving an element currently at value M-1 change per step; delta[v] = 2*S_v - c_v*(N-1) is the net inversion change when all value-v elements wrap M-1 -> 0, applied at step k = M-v.
Compute inv0 (strict-greater inversion count of A) with a Fenwick tree of size M in O(N log M); also collect c[v] and S[v] in the same pass.
Precompute delta[v] for all v using delta[v] = 2*S[v] - c[v]*(N-1).
Output M lines: inv0 for k=0, then iterate k=1..M-1 applying ans += delta[M-k] and printing each result.
Test against samples 1-3 and edge cases (M=1, all values equal, duplicates, N=1); confirmed wrap order M-1..1 and no off-by-one (all public samples pass).
